query: SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM kb_resources r JOIN kb_chunks ch ON ch.resource_id = r.id JOIN kb_content_blocks b ON b.id = ch.block_id WHERE r.is_active AND ch.is_current AND NOT b.is_folded AND ch.embedded_with IS DISTINCT FROM $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_erased_content ec WHERE ec.content_hash = ch.content_hash) AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR r.id = $2::uuid) AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_resource_homes h WHERE h.resource_id = r.id AND h.anchor_table = 'kb_contexts' AND h.anchor_id = $3::uuid)) LIMIT $4
